findings.issue: The main swap path, through a bin that holds liquidity, is cut after the amounts and fee computation: the write of self.reserveOfBin[activeId], the MaxLiquidityPerBinExceeded check (0x2d54cbbe never appears in swap), the protocol-fee accumulation and the loop's continuation (next bin or exit) are lost; only the empty-bin path continues (4210-5920). The marker sits after the if/else at 4127, which is the only hint that both arms continue into the aborted part.
findings.rule: Coverage limit of the decompiler (the loop body combines an unrolled pow, two mulDiv expansions and the TreeMath bit search). Printing the marker inside each arm that reaches it, rather than once after the if/else, would make the cut path unambiguous.
